history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all. Nothing loads, I can't send picture messages, and I can't get online or make a call.

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. First, I need to identify your account to check your line status and provide the right support.

Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the problem.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148. My name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for the information. Your line status is currently Active, which means there are no suspensions or contract issues on your account.

To help you further, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- “No Signal” or a signal strength indicator (bars)
- Any other unusual icons

This will help determine if the issue is with your device settings or something else. If you need guidance on how to check, let me know your phone model and I can assist!
I see the airplane mode icon and 'No Signal' in the status bar. Data is enabled, and the battery is at 87%.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections, including cellular service. This is why you have no signal and cannot make calls, use data, or send picture messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your device. After you do this, check if your signal returns and if you can use your phone normally. Let me know if you need instructions on how to turn off Airplane Mode or if the issue persists after turning it off.
Airplane mode is now off, but I still don't see any signal bars. It still says 'No Signal.' What should I try next?

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still see “No Signal,” the next step is to check your SIM card status, as it may not be properly seated or could have another issue.

Please check your SIM card status on your phone. If you need instructions on how to do this, let me know your phone model. Once you check, let me know if it says:
- SIM is active/ready
- SIM is missing
- SIM is locked (PIN/PUK required)
- Any other message

This will help determine the next steps to restore your service.
My SIM status says 'Locked.' What should I do about this?
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer's SIM card is locked (PIN/PUK required). Needs assistance unlocking SIM to restore service.
